lines.text: Wait, what? The party is tomorrow?

data.define: Used when you didn't understand or can't believe something.

example.text: Wait, what? The party is tomorrow?

misuse.text: Don't say 'wait, what' to your boss's order.

publish.title: What does "wait, what" mean?
publish.value: Wait, what = I'm confused and surprised. Example: "Wait, what? The party is tomorrow?" (casual English).
